finalPrompt: Edit this exact supplied aligned 1024x1536 full-body cartoon image to create a TEMPORARY PINK SOFT-TISSUE REPAIR UNDERLAY, not a final anatomical drawing. All red/blue blood vessels in limbs are already removed; keep them removed. Now remove ALL ivory/white long-bone shafts from BOTH ARMS and BOTH LEGS, including all upper-arm shafts, forearm shafts, femur shafts, shin shafts, foot and palm bone strips. Fill every removed bone shaft with salmon/pink soft muscle tissue that smoothly matches the surrounding red-pink muscle. No white or cream shafts/lines anywhere along arms, legs, hands, feet. You may retain ONLY the small ROUND ivory joint disks at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles. Do not extend these joint disks into white shafts. This image will only provide tiny pink repair patches inside old vessel footprints; final bones will be restored from the original in another layer. Maintain EXACT same outside body silhouette, poses, organ positions, white background, 1024x1536 framing and scale. Keep all head, chest, abdomen and internal organs unchanged. No new blood vessels, no new bones, no new details, no gore, no text. ALL non-round ivory limb shafts must become soft salmon pink tissue.
